does_not_cover: Stays discrete only: no densities, CDFs, or continuous counterparts despite the general title.
Never touches transformations of variables, covariance, or Chebyshev bounds.
No fitting or model-choice guidance: single fixed distribution worked throughout.
notes: Slow worked-example pacing with a simulation interlude. Law-of-large-numbers demo previews concentration ideas — reassignment signal, kept out of teaches except one low-confidence entry.

segments.topic: Setup: discrete distribution listing values and probabilities
Expectation formula as weighted average, plus expectation of g(X)
Variance definition and the E[X^2]-minus-mean-squared shortcut
Coin-toss example computing the mean 1.2 step by step
Million-draw simulation converging near the theoretical mean
Computing the expectation of the squared variable
Variance calculation 0.48 with shortcut verification and root for sd

Introduces capital-versus-lowercase notation and the value listing.
